one_line: AI labs disprove the Exponential Time Hypothesis, Anthropic secures massive gas-fired power, and midterms alter the US data center landscape.

themes.title: AI models disprove Exponential Time Hypothesis
themes.text: OpenAI and Anthropic published proofs in natural language and Lean format disproving the 27-year-old Exponential Time Hypothesis.

stories.headline: OpenAI and Anthropic AI models disprove Exponential Time Hypothesis

themes.title: Anthropic secures billions in gas generators
themes.text: Anthropic purchased commitments for 1.7GW of gas-fired generators from OnePWR for $3.4 billion, marking the largest known generator purchase by an AI lab.

stories.headline: Anthropic buys 1.7GW of gas-fired generators in $3.4B deal

themes.title: Midterm elections reshape data center politics
themes.text: Democratic midterm victories led to voter rejections of data centers and anti-data center politicians, while political spending by AI super PACs yielded mixed results.

stories.headline: After the midterms, things are looking rocky for Elon Musk and data centers
Anthropic-backed PAC Public First spent $63M+ in 2026 midterms
Pro-AI super PAC network Leading the Future falls short in midterms

themes.title: Copyright, deepfake, and data leak lawsuits
themes.text: The Elvis Presley estate sued Suno over voice cloning, a woman joined a lawsuit against xAI over Grok deepfakes, and researchers found Claude Code configuration files exposing company secrets.

stories.headline: Elvis Presley estate sues Suno over voice cloning and copyright infringement
Wyoming woman joins federal lawsuit against xAI over Grok deepfakes
Claude Code approval files expose company secrets on GitHub
